summary.zh: 高风险编码前先规划，逐个核对用到的 API 是否真实存在
summary.en: Plan risky coding work and confirm every API exists before coding

description.zh: 在认证、数据库迁移这类高风险改动前先做规划，拆出步骤并逐个核对用到的 import 与接口是否真实存在。适合多文件修改、旧系统改造，或需求里容易凭空编造接口的场景。改动很小时不必启用。
description.en: Plans high-stakes work such as auth changes, migrations and multi-file edits, then checks that every import and API really exists. Use it when a task is complex enough that invented interfaces are a real risk. Small edits do not need it.
